line_item_ids.title: Line Item Ids
line_item_ids.description: Specific line items to cancel. None or empty requests full order cancellation.

quote_id.title: Quote Id
quote_id.description: Signed checkout quote token issued by POST /api/cart/checkout/quote

payment_method_type.title: Payment Method Type
payment_method_type.description: Payment method choice (card, upi, net_banking, cash_on_delivery)

Money.title: Money
Money.description:
Canonical money format for the marketplace.
Backend calculations may use Decimal, but public JSON contracts use integers.
amount_minor is the amount in the minor unit of the currency (e.g. cents, paise).

PaymentIntent.title: PaymentIntent
PaymentIntent.description:
A canonical, provider-neutral public payment intent contract.
No provider-specific metadata or credentials are included here.

PincodeResult.title: PincodeResult
PincodeResult.description: Normalized postal geography metadata derived from an Indian Pincode.

PostOfficeInfo.title: PostOfficeInfo
PostOfficeInfo.description: Structured postal office information resolved from a postal index number.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description: Marketplace-owned profile fields. Email, phone and password belong to the auth service.

PublicUserProfile.title: PublicUserProfile
PublicUserProfile.description: Public user profile — safe to serialize and return to third-party authenticated users.

ShippingServiceabilityResult.title: ShippingServiceabilityResult
ShippingServiceabilityResult.description: Marketplace courier and logistics serviceability assessment.

UserContacts.title: UserContacts
UserContacts.description: Verified contact identifiers for a user account.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Full user profile — returned to self or admin callers.

UserProfileDetails.title: UserProfileDetails
UserProfileDetails.description: Rich user profile response containing dedicated Contacts and Addresses sections.

ZolexoraOrgLink.title: ZolexoraOrgLink
ZolexoraOrgLink.description: ZX-ORG id of the auth-service organisation whose employees are this seller's staff; null unlinks.
